'''Tierell''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tierell system/Legends|Tierell system]] within the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

Located at the intersection of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]], Tierell and the planet [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Feriae Junction]] were the two ports that serve most traffic coming and going from the [[Loop Worlds]] of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tierell is incorrectly spelled "Tierrel" on the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] map of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.
